title: Krasheninnikov volcano lava flows ENE/E flanks — daily thermal anomaly in satellite (KVERT)
snippet: KVERT reports lava flows at Krasheninnikov continued to effuse onto ENE and E flanks of Northern Cone during 22-29 April 2026. A large thermal anomaly identified daily in satellite images. Aviation Color Code Yellow. Effusive eruption activity continues. Located in Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia.
tag_reason: 신규: 이전 14일 보고서에 Krasheninnikov 관련 항목 없음. 위성 일별 열이상 관측 확인.
